project.name: Proof
project.summary: A Claude Code plugin harness for solo builders — spec → build → review → ship skills, review agents and safety hooks, installed from the jsamitt/proof-claude-plugin marketplace.

goals: Cheaper to run per issue — lower model and token cost of taking an issue from spec to ship
Reliable on real projects — skills and hooks work first time on projects like Samitt.com, with no setup traps

commands.test: for t in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$t" || exit 1; done

manual: Install the branch locally and run the changed skill end to end in a real project (e.g. Samitt.com)
If a hook or setup script changed: run it once against a real repo and check its output

risk_focus: Board stage options must only ever be set with their existing option IDs; sending options without IDs wipes every card's status on users' boards.

The safety hooks (pre-bash-guard, pre-write-guard) must never let destructive commands through, and must not block safe everyday commands — a false negative loses user work, a false positive makes people switch Proof off.
Skill and agent frontmatter must parse as YAML (quote any description containing ": "); a parse error loads the skill with empty frontmatter and it silently stops being offered.
Manifest changes (plugin.json, marketplace.json, hooks.json) can stop the plugin loading for every user on update; the version in plugin.json and marketplace.json must match.
Proof carries no project facts: skills must never hardcode one project's commands, names or URLs — those belong in harness.json.
Scripts must run on macOS's bash 3.2.

steps.name: Users pick it up with `claude plugin update proof@proof` (cloud sessions and the digest fetch it fresh) — no deploy
